notes.title: Update v.1.0.3
notes.notes: [p]Based on the valuable feedback from you, our players, the following issues have been identified and resolved:[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Identified and Fixed Issues:[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Fixed the issue where doors and objects were not triggering properly during interactions.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS performance has been improved.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS limit options in the Settings menu have been updated.[/p][/*][*][p]Character stamina system has been optimized.[/p][/*][*][p]Trigger and animation issue in the final scene has been resolved.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.0.2
notes.notes: [p][b]Camera Angle Adjustment System Added and Identified Bugs Fixed[/b][/p][p][/p][h2]New Feature[/h2][list][*][p]An adjustment option has been added for the camera's POV value.[/p][/*][/list][h2][b]Identified Bugs[/b][/h2][list][*][p]Delay issues occurring during interactions have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS optimization has been implemented.[/p][/*][*][p]The non-functional "Gamma" percentage setting in the settings menu has been removed and replaced with a notification displaying "Low" and "High" options.[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Update v.1.0.1
notes.notes: [p]Thanks to your valuable feedback during the early access phase, we have addressed and fixed several gameplay-related issues.[/p][p][/p][h2][b]Resolved Issues[/b][/h2][list][*][p]The issue causing the game to end prematurely due to timing errors has been resolved. You can now enjoy a longer and more stable early access experience.[/p][/*][*][p]Animation glitches in the final scene have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Glare problems on certain objects have been corrected.[/p][/*][*][p]FPS (frames per second) improvements have been made.[/p][/*][/list]
